glossEn: building material consisting of a piece of rock hewn in a definite shape for a special purpose
note: building material consisting of a piece of rock hewn in a definite shape for a special purpose。最常见义项。

glossEn: an avoirdupois unit used to measure the weight of a human body; equal to 14 pounds
note: 英文独有义位 an avoirdupois unit equal to 14 pounds。英国重量单位。

glossEn: the hard inner (usually woody) layer of the pericarp of some fruits (as peaches or plums or cherries or olives) that contains the seed
note: the hard inner layer of the pericarp of some fruits (peaches, plums, olives) that contains the seed。
